title: biosig-zarr format version 3: timestamped group metadata document
description: The zarr.json of a timestamped group (a channel group with one explicit time per sample) in a format version 3 store, transcribed from spec/index.md on the branch draft/3.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two values or two documents, such as time_range and the first and last values of time, are not expressed. Unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: Hierarchy: a timestamped group is a Zarr group, named in timestamped_groups. Timestamped groups: the attributes of a timestamped group, in addition to those of every group.

node_type.$comment: Hierarchy: a channel group is a group.

attributes.$comment: Channel groups and Timestamped groups: the REQUIRED rows of the table of attributes of every group and of the table of attributes of a timestamped group.

kind.$comment: Channel groups: every channel group carries kind, uniform or timestamped; this is a timestamped group.

n_samples.$comment: Timestamped groups: n_samples MUST be at least 1.

time_range.description: Timestamped groups: the first and the last value of time.

continuity.$comment: Timestamped groups: continuous, step, instantaneous, or unknown.

not.$comment: Timestamped groups: a timestamped group MUST NOT carry the attribute rate.

effective_rate.$comment: Timestamped groups: effective_rate is null when n_samples is 1.

channel.description: Channel groups, Channel objects: a channel of a timestamped group.

not.$comment: Timestamped groups: channel objects in a timestamped group have no original_rate, target_rate or anti_aliased, which are CONDITIONAL, present in a uniform group.
